title: Standing Register
description: The Standing state variable: who can challenge which decisions or delegations, with what procedural force. Exposure to system failure generates standing to initiate correction; standing is procedural force, not veto (Law VII). The register lists, per decision class, who may challenge, what may be challenged, what evidence is admissible, who must respond and by when, the standard of review, and the state transitions a challenge can force.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the register conforms to.

register_id.title: Register identifier
register_id.description: Stable identifier for the register, referenced by challenges.

system_ref.title: System reference
system_ref.description: Identifier of the system whose decisions this register governs.

decision_classes.title: Decision classes
decision_classes.description: One entry per class of consequential decision.

items.title: Decision class entry
items.description: Standing rules for one decision class.

decision_class.title: Decision class
decision_class.description: Name of the decision class, matching the action class or decision type used in decision records.

who_may_challenge.title: Who may challenge
who_may_challenge.description: Parties with standing, proportional to their exposure: affected parties, corrective labor, representatives, oversight bodies.

what_may_be_challenged.title: What may be challenged
what_may_be_challenged.description: Which objects a challenge may target: a decision, the grant behind it, or the policy behind the grant.

admissible_evidence.title: Admissible evidence
admissible_evidence.description: Kinds of evidence a challenger may submit.

responder.title: Responder
responder.description: The accountable person or role who must answer the challenge.

response_deadline.title: Response deadline
response_deadline.description: Maximum time to respond, as an ISO 8601 duration such as P5D or PT48H.

standard_of_review.title: Standard of review
standard_of_review.description: The test the responder applies when deciding whether the challenged object still deserves to stand.

possible_state_transitions.title: Possible state transitions
possible_state_transitions.description: Outcomes a challenge can force, matching reconsideration outcomes. This is the procedural force standing carries.
